name: zgeometry_polygon_convexify
description: zGeometry_Polygon::Convexify converts input polygon spans into a convex polygon set, copying triangles and convex quads directly and deferring non-convex spans to triangulation.
known_limits: The smoke target covers null-input rejection plus direct triangle and convex-quad copy paths; non-convex split output is covered through accepted triangulation helper targets and deferred to the coherent convexification cluster pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry convexification source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46c760 validates null/empty input rejection, result allocation, output point and polygon allocation sizing, span loop, skip for undersized spans, direct triangle copy, convex quad copy, triangulation path for larger/non-convex spans, invalid-size error cleanup, and return of the populated convex set.
The native convexify smoke verifies null rejection and a mixed triangle/convex-quad span array with expected output polygon counts, dword offsets, copied points, and total point count.
